subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should OpenClaw add WhatsApp unauthorized-group auto-leave and group-add notification as an opt-in plugin feature now, and what trigger and authorization contract should it use?
rationale: The current code proves the requested behavior is missing, but adding auto-leave or a manual leave action changes a security boundary and introduces destructive account behavior plus new config/event surfaces.

options.title: Design opt-in WhatsApp contract first
options.body: Define group admission, join-event, and leave authorization semantics, then implement the selected WhatsApp plugin behavior with tests and live WhatsApp proof.

options.title: Defer to shared group pairing
options.body: Keep this linked to the broader group-pairing design and avoid a WhatsApp-specific hook until shared owner-notification semantics are settled.

options.title: Keep allowlist-only posture
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw should keep dropping unauthorized WhatsApp group traffic and document manual cleanup instead of adding auto-leave behavior.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in WhatsApp contract first
recommendation.body: Define group admission, join-event, and leave authorization semantics, then implement the selected WhatsApp plugin behavior with tests and live WhatsApp proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest mix of prior review context and recent WhatsApp config/action/docs history among the routing candidates.
